items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I guess we've come to the point where you went with Louie Armstrong. Spring of 1949.... Let's talk about that. ... I did about two or three record dates there with Louie.

ctx.x: Then Claude Jones was there, trombone; then Tyree and Keg Johnson.

Pop Smith I heard of a record he did with Fletcher Henderson around 1930 and he was hitting like a high up then. And you know Louie Armstrong was doing that like a clown act at the time. But had written into the arrangement. Pops was hitting it.
Yeah Pop Smith, he had two brothers, Luke and Joe, all of them were good trumpet players. Luke Smith and Joe Smith. All of them were with Fletcher Henderson, all of them great trumpet players.
